dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Boby arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as social but prefers contact on his terms. They also stated that Boby will bark at strangers, growl, and show teeth. While in care, Boby has been highly fearful and will freeze when handlers attempt to interact. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an adult only home.
dog.name: Boby
